# TODO002: todo-ticket-terminal

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | TODO |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | warn |
| tier | universal |
| scope | repo |
| fix | manual |
| polarity | P+ |
| must_measure | true |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A `frob:todo` directive points at a ticket that is already done or dropped.

The ticket named by the directive is in the terminal category, so the work
it owned is finished (or abandoned) yet the marker remains. Do the work,
remove the marker, or re-point it at a live ticket.

## Examples

### TODO002 todo owned by a terminal ticket / Fires when the ticket is done #1 (line 6) (fire)

```rust
/* frob:todo {{DONE}} finish it */ // warn: TODO002
fn a() {}
```

### TODO002 todo owned by a terminal ticket / Clean when the ticket is open #2 (line 13) (clean)

```rust
/* frob:todo {{OPEN}} finish it */
fn a() {}
```
